s.t: What changes did Gotham make to their plan last year?

layers.nm: Major Benefits & Policy Changes  Remote-First Work Model. Gotham transitioned to a remote-first culture. They give employees flexibility to work where they thrive, while still maintaining offices globally and hosting in-person onboarding and team touchpoints. This was a significant structural shift from any prior office-centric model.  Parental Leave Maternity leave- 16 weeks fully paid Paternity leave- 4 weeks fully paid Family medical leave assistance also available.  Unlimited PTO & Sabbatical. Gotham offers unlimited PTO and a sabbatical program - notable differentiators among tech employers. 2
